units.name: Operations Department
units.evidence: Official department page explicitly names Operations Department and manufacturing, service and supply-chain research.

units.name: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management Sciences
units.school: Robert R. McCormick School of Engineering and Applied Science
units.evidence: About page explicitly gives full departmental name, optimization/stochastics/simulation operations research and logistics applications; copyright supplies full school name.

units.name: Center for Optimization and Statistical Learning
units.school: Robert R. McCormick School of Engineering and Applied Science
units.evidence: Named interdisciplinary engineering center researches optimization methods and models; departmental center inventory confirms manufacturing and other applications.

units.name: Center for Engineering and Health
units.school: Feinberg School of Medicine; Robert R. McCormick School of Engineering and Applied Science
units.evidence: Joint medical/engineering center explicitly develops healthcare delivery methods, resource allocation, forecasting and process-efficiency tools; member of Institute for Public Health and Medicine.

units.name: Northwestern University Transportation Center
units.school: Robert R. McCormick School of Engineering and Applied Science
units.evidence: Official center page establishes engineering-school home and explicit humanitarian logistics, logistics/SCM research and freight operations remit.

decisions.reason: Official related unit describes economics/political science or science-of-science innovation, not an explicitly operations/IE/SCM unit; excluded under requested scope.

sources.note: Full industrial engineering department name and operations research scope.
Optimization center full name, engineering parent and methods remit.
Healthcare operations/resource allocation remit and joint school hierarchy.
Transportation center parent and logistics/SCM remit.
MEDS page describes economists/political scientists, microeconomics, game theory and political economy; excluded as separate operations unit.
Science of Science center studies scientific production and innovation using computational social science; no explicit operations unit remit established.
Engineering center inventory distinguishes related centers.
Engineering faculty page confirms department and full university/school identity.

limitations: Related economics, scientific-innovation and general AI centers are not classified as operations units solely because of methodological overlap.
